name: AI Discoverability & Engagement Audit Marketplace
description: A composable marketplace of read-only audit skills that measure how well a website can be crawled, rendered, extracted, understood, trusted and navigated by AI answer engines and autonomous agents.

contracts.evidence_policy: Every finding must cite the page URL, the observed HTTP status and at least one reproducible measurement. Findings that cannot satisfy this contract are rejected at construction time.
contracts.semantic_evidence_policy: Every semantic observation must cite evidence ids issued by this run; quoted text is checked as a verbatim substring of the cited section; numbers, technology names and URLs absent from the cited evidence are rejected. Observations are promoted into findings only under lib/llm/validation.py::promotion_decision, and never in shadow mode.

skills.name: Audit Orchestrator
skills.description: Entrypoint skill. Plans the audit, invokes the specialist skills in dependency order, deduplicates and prioritises their findings, and emits the final structured report.

skills.name: Crawl & Render Audit
skills.description: Fetches the site read-only, builds the shared site snapshot, and detects machine access barriers: unreachable pages, robots/noindex blocks, and business content that only exists after client-side JavaScript execution.

skills.name: Content & Semantics Audit
skills.description: Measures whether the facts a buyer would ask about are present as machine-readable text: extractable body content, JSON-LD/microdata structured data, and facts locked inside images.

skills.name: Entity & Freshness Audit
skills.description: Cross-references the organisation name across title, H1, JSON-LD, OpenGraph, footer copyright and body prose to detect entity ambiguity, and dates every factual claim to detect stale content.

skills.name: Engagement & Orientation Audit
skills.description: Measures on-site orientation: navigation landmarks, internal link graph, breadcrumbs, and next-step affordances that let a visitor (or an agent following a citation) continue instead of dead-ending.

skills.name: Sentiment & Semantic Engagement Audit
skills.description: Reads the site's own copy aspect by aspect - value proposition, pricing, shipping, returns, support, trust, CTAs, error messages, tone consistency - and proposes evidence-cited observations about where the writing itself loses a visitor or an answer engine. Emits observations, never findings; promotion is the orchestrator's decision and is disabled by default.

llm.guarantee: With the layer off the marketplace performs no LLM call, requires no API key, and emits exactly the deterministic report it emitted before the layer existed.
llm.failure_policy: An LLM failure is an audit limitation reported in audit_health; it never blocks the deterministic report and never becomes a finding about the site.

crawl_profiles.note: The extended profile must be requested explicitly (AUDIT_CRAWL_PROFILE=extended); the shipped default reproduces the original crawl scope exactly.
